title.en: Expansive inventory of food and supplies

text.en: Shoppers consistently describe this long-standing Homestead shop as a comprehensive destination for animal supplies. Reviewers appreciate finding everything from popular dog food brands and bird feeds to cages, accessories, and farm animal supplies. While one customer found the store compact, most emphasize the convenience of finding complete selections under one roof.

Customer feedback highlights the helpful and respectful attitude of the store staff and cashiers. Visitors frequently remark on employees willingness to answer questions about pet care, guide shoppers toward proper food formulas, and create a welcoming family atmosphere. Many longtime patrons express complete trust in the store recommendations.

title.en: Diverse live animals with health warnings

text.en: Visitors enjoy the wide variety of live animals on display, including colorful birds, fish, reptiles, rabbits, and farm poultry. Families often describe trips to the shop as engaging experiences for children. However, critical reviewers raise health concerns, warning of mite infestations among purchased reptiles and reporting adverse reactions to flea medication.

q.en: What types of animals and feeds are sold at Robert Pet Shop?

a.en: The store carries food and supplies for dogs, cats, birds, fish, reptiles, rabbits, and various farm animals.

q.en: Are live animals available for purchase?

a.en: Yes, the shop features live birds, fish, reptiles, bunnies, and poultry, though reviewers advise careful inspection before purchasing reptiles.

q.en: Can staff help answer questions about animal nutrition?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently praise knowledgeable employees who help select appropriate skin-and-coat diets and specialized feeds.

q.en: Is the shop suitable for family visits with children?

a.en: Many shoppers enjoy bringing children to view and interact with the wide variety of animals housed throughout the store.
